template: Hey {first_name}, I know that you do {x}. Congrats on {specific}. Was wondering if I can run something by you.
template_no_name: Hey, I know that you do {x}. Congrats on {specific}. Was wondering if I can run something by you.
cold_read_template: Hey {first_name}, I know that you do {x}. {cold_read} Was wondering if I can run something by you.
cold_read_template_no_name: Hey, I know that you do {x}. {cold_read} Was wondering if I can run something by you.
x_rules: 3-10 words, service first. Name the niche. Lowercase except proper names and acronyms. No company or place names, pronouns, numbers, dashes, ampersands, marketing words, AI or automation.

Ground X in the company own site. For an unreachable site, use only a reliable company_description or headline, never invent a service or specialization. Keep the exact quote and URL or lead_field. Hold when identity or niche is uncertain.
specific_rules: Pick the first supported achievement kind in achievement_kinds, strongest first. 3-14 spoken words completing Congrats on. Preserve exact numbers, names, attribution and stated dates; $6 million, not $6M; over 500, not 500+. Never name client companies or demographic groups.

Evidence must be an exact quote on a retained company page. A client result must describe this agency contribution, not a client standalone statistic or pooled result. Never generic congrats. No achievement: approved niche-matched cold read instead, otherwise hold for wording review.

Keep x_evidence and specific_evidence with quote and url. Retain all candidate achievements for an alternative for a second contact at the same company. Human semantic review is required. Do not add a sentence or clause that only restates or sells the preceding point.

marketing_agency: Fantastic work on the campaigns. I can tell you really care about the leads and not just the clicks.
Great work on the campaigns. I can tell you're big on tracking what actually turns into revenue.
Fantastic work on the accounts. I can tell you stay on top of them instead of setting and forgetting.
Great work with your clients. I can tell you're upfront with them about the numbers.
Fantastic work on the Amazon accounts. I can tell you care about profit and not just sales.
Great work with your brands on Amazon. I can tell you really dig into the numbers.

specialty_rules: Recruiting leads only: `specialty` is the 1 to 4 word niche they recruit for, to fill 'I watch for {specialty} roles sitting open on job boards'. Examples: 'commercial HVAC and electrical', 'agtech and foodtech', 'executive'. Must read naturally before the word 'roles'. Blank for other campaigns or if no specialty is known (the email falls back to a generic).

writer_policy.reviewer: Codex self-review or authorized OpenAI/Codex reviewer
writer_policy.note: Do not invoke Anthropic, Claude or Opus. No separate API subscription required for local research/render/review.
